description: Defines an interface for a JSON Web Key (JWK) with methods to access key parameters and a nested class listing JSON field definitions.

classes.name: JsonWebKey
classes.description: Interface representing a JSON Web Key with methods to retrieve key parameters.

classes.name: JsonWebKey.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for a JSON Web Key.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the algorithm parameter as an Optional.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns the usage parameter as an Optional.

methods.name: getModulus
methods.description: Returns the modulus parameter as a BigInteger.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent parameter as a BigInteger.
